summary: ReNew Energy Global plc filed a Form 6-K on August 24, 2026, notifying shareholders of its fifth Annual General Meeting scheduled for September 16, 2026, in London, and announcing the publication of its Annual Report under the UK Companies Act for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026. This is a routine corporate governance communication, not a special situation. No transaction, strategic action, or management change is involved. The filing includes forward-looking statements and company background, but no deal terms, pricing, or M&A activity. The AGM notice and annual report are available on the company's website.
